Michael B. Jordan performed his own action scenes in Without Remorse (2021), including some of the movie’s most intense sequences, with no stunt doubles.

To prepare for the role, he underwent serious Special Forces-style training alongside former Navy SEALs, military combat specialists, and diving experts. He trained in weapons handling, hand-to-hand combat, skydiving, and deep diving to make his performance feel as authentic as possible.

His physical preparation was just as intense. Jordan followed a strict diet of five to six meals a day, used supplements, and had regular massages and recovery sessions to keep his body in shape and avoid injuries during filming.
